record.metal: bimetallic (CuNi center / Ni-brass ring) · 7.50 g · 23.25 mm · interrupted milled · circulated · white 2×2 staple flip
record.design: national Leonardo’s Vitruvian Man (Laura Cretara) + RI · date · R · 12 EU stars · common map side (Luc Luycx)

payload.story: A 1970 Swiss 1-franc coin. The front shows Helvetia, the figure of Switzerland, standing with a spear and shield; the back shows the value inside a wreath of oak and alpine flowers. Engraved by Antoine Bovy, Albert Walch and Fr. Fisch, and struck in copper-nickel (75% copper, 25% nickel).
